description.value: Ditidaht-operated campground on the shores of Nitinaht Lake — a 20 km ocean fjord renowned for consistent thermal winds and a world-class windsurfing and kitesurfing scene — also serving as the West Coast Trail's third entry point; outhouse facilities only, advance online reservation required, and access is via remote logging roads.

address.value: Area F (Cowichan Lake South / Skutz Falls), BC

raw_osm.addr:city: Area F (Cowichan Lake South / Skutz Falls)
raw_osm.name: Nitinaht Lake Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at visitnitinaht.com corroborates the OSM record: same phone number (778-817-0162), same operator (Ditidaht First Nation), and confirms tents and small RVs are accepted. The /book-your-site/ page confirms 2026 season dates (April 27–October 4, 2026), indicating the campground is currently open, though a fire-related booking suspension notice appears on several subpages that may be stale. The FAQ explicitly states West Coast Trail hikers with tents do not require reservations, supporting a hiker/biker sites designation, and the Visitor Centre/General Store on site confirms food nearby.
concerns: A fire-related booking suspension notice ('unable to accept bookings until further notice') appears on multiple subpages but the /book-your-site/ page lists 2026 season dates (April 27–October 4, 2026), suggesting the notice is stale; worth verifying current operational status.

The /book-your-site/ page refers to the facility as 'Caycuse Recreation Site Campground' rather than 'Nitinaht Lake Campground' — may be an alternate name for part of the property or a rebranding; worth confirming.
OSM address is an administrative area (Area F), not a civic street address; no more precise address is provided on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operated First Nations campground directly on the West Coast Trail corridor with hiker/biker-friendly no-reservation spots and an on-site general store — highly relevant to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pay-per-use WiFi hotspots are available on site (confirmed via FAQ); each campsite includes a picnic table and fire ring. Communal outhouse facilities are stocked on site. OSM lists 6 cabins and 104 sites; website's 2019 expansion plans targeted 120 tent sites and 12 RV sites.

wow_evidence: Ditidaht-operated... West Coast Trail's third entry point... West Coast Trail hikers with tents do not require reservations... Visitor Centre/General Store on site
